extName.message: Tabachment – Gmail attachments in a new tab
extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store (max 75 characters).

extDescription.message: Click a PDF, image, text, video or audio attachment in Gmail and it opens right in a new tab: no preview pop-up, no download.
extDescription.description: Extension summary shown in Chrome and the Chrome Web Store (max 132 characters).

cardButtonLabel.description: Short label of the button shown on Gmail attachment cards.

cardButtonTitle.description: Tooltip of the button shown on Gmail attachment cards.

openingStatus.description: Shown in the new tab while the attachment loads.

openingHint.message: If the file did not appear, it may have been downloaded instead. Check your downloads, or open it again.
openingHint.description: Shown in the new tab if the attachment did not replace the placeholder page.

openingReopen.description: Button that loads the attachment in the tab again.

optInterceptClicks.message: Open it in a new tab
optInterceptClicks.description: Setting: clicking a supported attachment opens it in a new tab.

optInterceptClicksHint.message: Supported files open in a new tab instead of Gmail's preview. Other files keep Gmail's usual behavior.

optOpenInBackground.description: Setting: open the new tab without switching to it.

optOpenInBackgroundHint.message: Stay in Gmail; the file opens in the tab next to it.

optShowButton.message: Show a “New tab” button on attachments
optShowButton.description: Setting: show the button on attachment cards.

optShowButtonHint.message: Appears when you point at an attachment, and works even when “Open it in a new tab” is off.

optionsKinds.description: Heading of the file type settings.

kindImageHint.message: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, BMP, ICO, AVIF
kindImageHint.description: Formats covered by the image setting.

kindTextHint.message: TXT, CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML, logs and source code
kindTextHint.description: Formats covered by the text setting.

kindVideoHint.description: Formats covered by the video setting.

kindAudioHint.message: MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG, FLAC, AAC
kindAudioHint.description: Formats covered by the audio setting.

kindOtherNote.message: Other files (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ZIP, HTML, …) keep Gmail's own preview.
kindOtherNote.description: Note below the file type settings.

tipAltClick.message: Hold Alt (Option on a Mac) while clicking to use Gmail's own preview.

tipCtrlClick.message: Ctrl-click (⌘-click on a Mac) or middle-click opens the file in a background tab.

tipPdfDownload.message: If PDFs are still downloaded, go to Chrome Settings › Privacy and security › Site settings › Additional content settings › PDF documents and choose “Open PDFs in Chrome”.

privacyNote.message: Tabachment runs entirely in your browser and collects no data.
privacyNote.description: Privacy statement in the options page footer.
